question: Should Android system sharing become a supported app entry point once imports are staged atomically and proven on a device?
rationale: This adds a new exported platform entry point and user workflow; code review can define a safe implementation but cannot establish product sponsorship.

options.title: Sponsor atomic share import
options.body: Accept Android Sharesheet parity after the delivery race is repaired and cold- and warm-launch device proof is attached.

options.title: Pause the entry point
options.body: Keep the linked feature issue open but pause this PR until Android share-import UX is prioritized.

recommendation.title: Sponsor atomic share import
recommendation.body: Accept Android Sharesheet parity after the delivery race is repaired and cold- and warm-launch device proof is attached.
